voice.summary: Headroom sounds like a thoughtful manager who looks after people's weeks. It states hours and overloads plainly, and frames fixes as moves to try rather than failures.
dos: Show hours alongside names, never bare percentages
Frame an overload as a choice with a next step
donts: Do not call people resources or headcount
Never celebrate full utilisation as a goal

taglines: See the week before it happens
Spot overload while it is small
Plan the load, protect the team
boilerplate: Headroom is a team workload dashboard that shows who is booked, who is stretched and who has room, so managers can rebalance before anyone burns out.
